environment: Local Texa Docker Postgres, production-like public warehouse tables; read-only SELECT queries
metric_definition: Native source revenue summed only on Cosmetics purchase or Olist order_purchased event rows. Olist payment_made is a distinct metric and is not used for item revenue.

cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS purchase_rows, sum(revenue) AS revenue, min(currency) AS currency, max(currency) AS currency_check FROM analytics.event_activity_cosmetics_shop WHERE event_name='purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31';

SELECT date_trunc('month',event_date)::date AS month, count(*) AS purchase_rows, sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics.event_activity_cosmetics_shop WHERE event_name='purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2020-01-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT item_category, count(*) AS purchase_rows, sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics.event_activity_cosmetics_shop WHERE event_name='purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY item_category ORDER BY sum(revenue) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3;
cases.caveat: NULL item_category is genuinely the largest group; UI should disclose missing category if displayed. Excluding NULL changes the question and should not be done silently.

cases.sql: SELECT item_category, count(*) AS purchase_rows, sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics.event_activity_cosmetics_shop WHERE event_name='purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND item_category='accessories' GROUP BY item_category;

SELECT count(*) AS purchase_item_rows, sum(revenue) AS item_revenue, min(currency) AS currency, max(currency) AS currency_check FROM analytics.event_activity_olist_marketplace WHERE event_name='order_purchased' AND event_date BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-01-31';
cases.caveat: Purchase item rows, not unique order count. Payment control is 7563 payment_made rows totaling BRL 1115004.18; do not substitute it for item revenue.

cases.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM analytics.event_activity_cosmetics_shop WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31'
